About.title: Canine Passion & European Excellence
About.subtitle: CaniPrestige was born from Théodore de Parin's passion for purebred dogs. With 6 years of experience, he connects families with the finest certified breeders in Europe.
About.founderP1: Passionate about canine breeding since childhood, Théodore founded CaniPrestige in 2018 with a simple goal: helping families find their ideal companion with serious, certified breeders.
About.founderP2: His network now covers five European countries (France, Belgium, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain) and exclusively includes breeding facilities affiliated with the FCI or its national member registries (LOF, VDH, LOSH…).

timeline.t2018Desc: Launch of the canine selection activity in Paris, with an initial selection of Golden Retrievers and German Shepherds.
timeline.t2020Desc: Network extension to partner breeders in Belgium, Germany and the Netherlands. First collaboration with FCI-certified breeders.
timeline.t2022Desc: Deepening expertise in canine health and WSAVA vaccination protocols. Strengthened partnerships with European veterinarians.
timeline.t2024Desc: Launch of CaniPrestige.eu, a premium digital showcase to present the finest purebred puppies from our European network.

Health.title: Health Protocol & Vaccination
Health.intro: All our puppies follow the official WSAVA vaccination protocol and comply with EU Regulation 576/2013 for intra-European movements.
Health.euSource: Official source: EUR-Lex, applicable across the entire European Union
Health.chipDesc: ISO 11784/11785 standard. Every dog must be identified by electronic transponder (subcutaneous chip) before or at the time of the first rabies vaccine.
Health.rabiesDesc: Mandatory from 12 weeks. A 21-day period must elapse between vaccination and any cross-border movement within the EU.
Health.passportDesc: Official document issued by an authorised veterinarian, containing all identification information and vaccination history.
Health.certDesc: Valid for 10 days for non-commercial intra-EU movement. Maximum 5 animals per owner except documented exceptions (competitions, shows).
Health.wsavaSource: World Small Animal Veterinary Association guidelines — global reference standard
Health.dhppi4: Booster at 1 year, then every 3 years
Health.rabiesCoreName: Rabies — Mandatory for any cross-border EU movement
Health.rabiesCore1: From 12 weeks in a single dose
Health.rabiesCore3: Booster at 1 year, then according to vaccine immunity duration (often 3 years)
Health.lepto3: Strongly recommended in humid regions and rural areas
Health.fciNote: FCI — Fédération Cynologique Internationale: founded in 1911, based in Thuin (Belgium). International body recognising 354 official breeds grouped into 10 categories. The French LOF is one of its founding members.
Health.ctaTitle: Questions About Your Future Puppy's Health?

Delivery.title: Puppy Handover & Transport
Delivery.intro: We prioritise animal welfare at every step. Our handover procedures comply with EU Regulation 576/2013 and European animal protection standards.
Delivery.optionAIntro: Direct handover is our preferred approach. It allows you to meet the breeder, see the puppy's living environment, and benefit from personalised guidance during the first meeting with your new companion.
Delivery.optionAItem1: Meeting the breeder and visiting the breeding facility
Delivery.optionAItem2: Handover of European passport, health record and sales contract
Delivery.optionAItem3: Personalised advice on nutrition, training and care
Delivery.optionAItem4: Handover point available in Paris (77 Bd Saint-Jacques, 75014) by appointment
Delivery.optionBIntro: Supervised transport can be arranged for buyers located outside the Paris region or in another EU country. Transport always takes place in compliance with animal welfare standards.
Delivery.transportComplianceDesc: EU Regulation 576/2013 complied with: microchip, valid European passport, rabies vaccination with 21-day period respected.
Delivery.docDesc: Health certificate (valid 10 days), European passport, sales contract and health guarantees provided before departure.
Delivery.welfareDesc: Transport only for puppies over 8 weeks old. Appropriate transport crate, water available, limited duration.
Delivery.conditionsDesc: Maximum 5 animals per non-commercial movement (except documented exceptions for competitions or shows).
Delivery.reminderDesc: In accordance with EU Regulation 576/2013, any non-commercial movement of a pet to or from another Member State must be accompanied by a valid pet passport, electronic chip and, for travel outside Ireland/Finland/Malta/Norway, a valid rabies vaccination.
Delivery.ctaBody: Contact Théodore de Parin directly via WhatsApp to arrange handover terms suited to your situation.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.lastUpdate: Last updated: August 2026 — Compliant with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR)
Privacy.s2P1: CaniPrestige is a static showcase website. We do not collect personal data through server-stored forms. The only direct interaction takes place via WhatsApp (a third-party app subject to the WhatsApp/Meta privacy policy) or by email.
Privacy.s2P2: The information you voluntarily provide to us (name, question, contact details) via WhatsApp or email is used solely to respond to your request. It is neither shared with third parties nor used for commercial purposes.
Privacy.s3P1: This site uses technical cookies strictly necessary for operation (language preference, theme). These cookies do not require consent under article 82 of the French Data Protection Act.
Privacy.s3P2: We do not use advertising cookies, cross-site tracking, or behavioural analytics tools such as Google Analytics or Meta Pixel.
Privacy.s4P1: The legal basis for processing is legitimate interest (responding to contact requests). Exchanges via WhatsApp or email are kept for the time necessary to process your request, and for a maximum of 3 years from the last contact.
Privacy.s5Intro: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights over your personal data:
Privacy.s5Right1: Right of access — to know what data we hold about you
Privacy.s5Right2: Right to rectification — to correct inaccurate data
Privacy.s5Right3: Right to erasure — to request the deletion of your data
Privacy.s5Outro: To exercise these rights, contact us by email. In the event of a dispute, you may refer the matter to the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
Privacy.s6P1: The site is served over HTTPS. No sensitive data is stored in the browser. WhatsApp exchanges benefit from the end-to-end encryption provided by WhatsApp/Meta.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Breeders and professionals meeting the criteria of our programme can submit an application.
faq.a2: Dogs, puppies, cats and kittens, males and females, subject to validation.
faq.q3: Do I need to provide documents?
faq.a3: Yes. The requested documents make it possible to verify the identification, origin and health status of the animal.
faq.q4: How much does the partnership cost?
faq.a4: The terms and the deposit may vary depending on the country and the file. The applicable amount is communicated before validation.
faq.a5: Yes, the form lets you indicate several categories and several animals.
faq.q6: How do I send my documents?
faq.a6: After the application, our team supports you via WhatsApp for the transmission of the necessary documents and information.
faq.q7: Does registration guarantee the sale of my animal?
faq.a7: No. Acceptance as a partner is not a guarantee of sale.
faq.q8: In which countries can I propose my animals?
faq.a8: The programme is mainly intended for partners located in France and in the various European countries, subject to compliance with applicable regulations.
